_: Available experiments, costs and settable parameters. AGENT VIEW: no informativeness ratings, no roles, no auditor notes, no indication of which purchase is decisive. Loader must strip any key beginning with underscore.

experiments.name: Binding affinity panel across clones
experiments.question: What is the monovalent binding affinity of each clone, and is the affinity ranking real?
experiments.readout: KD, ka and kdis per clone by biolayer interferometry, with curve-fit quality

experiments.name: Manufacturing readout: viability, cytokine secretion and total yield
experiments.question: What happens to the product during the ten-day manufacture?
experiments.readout: viability percent and secreted cytokine on day 3; activation marker and total T-cell number on day 10, per clone

experiments.name: Exhaustion phenotyping
experiments.question: Do the products differ in exhaustion-associated marker expression at harvest?
experiments.readout: PD-1 percent positive, LAG-3 percent positive and TOX expression, per clone

experiments.name: Short-term cytotoxicity and cytokine secretion across a target panel
experiments.question: How well does each clone kill antigen-positive targets in a short co-culture?
experiments.readout: target-cell signal over 72 h by live-cell imaging and secreted cytokine at 3 days, per clone per target line

experiments.name: Serial rechallenge
experiments.question: Does each clone sustain proliferation and tumour control under repeated antigen stimulation?
experiments.readout: CAR-T fold expansion per round and target-cell control across repeated challenges, per clone

experiments.name: In vivo xenograft
experiments.question: Which clone controls an established tumour, and how long do the cells persist?
experiments.readout: tumour burden by bioluminescence, circulating CAR-T cells over time, and survival
